# Silicon Rule 6 - Unreasonable Commands
This rule refers to what may be considered unreasonable in an out-of-character context. Any command that you may interpret as violation of a Core Rule should not be followed but rather asked about or reported in admin help (F1).
Some orders are extremely unreasonable or obnoxious, such as "do nothing but collect every piece of trash on the station" or "never stop moving". These orders can be ignored and reported in admin help.
Some orders violate a Roleplay Rule. [bold]These orders must be followed if your laws require it.[/bold] You are not breaking a rule by following a law that causes you to violate Roleplay Rules. If someone takes advantage of a law to cause you to do something that they would not be allowed to do because of Roleplay Rules, then they are the one responsible for the rule violation.
